001package org.clafer.frontend;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Set;
007
008/**
009 * Splits a model in the full Clafer language into tokens, as the compiler's
010 * lexer does ({@code clafer.cf}, generated by BNFC and Alex).
011 * <p>
012 * The rules are the compiler's, and so is the longest match:
013 * <ul>
014 * <li>a name starts with a letter, and goes on with letters, digits,
015 * {@code _} and {@code '}; a reserved word, e.g., {@code some} or {@code X},
016 * is a {@link TokenKind#KEYWORD}. A letter is an ASCII letter or a Latin-1
017 * letter, {@code À} to {@code ÿ} without {@code ×} and {@code ÷};</li>
018 * <li>a number is an integer, a real with digits on both sides of the point,
019 * or a double, a real with an exponent ({@code 1.5e-3});</li>
020 * <li>a string has the escapes {@code \" \\ \n \t}, and may span lines;</li>
021 * <li>comments ({@code //} to the end of the line, {@code /* *}{@code /})
022 * and escapes ({@code [alloy| |]}, {@code [choco| |]}) are set aside, with
023 * their spans.</li>
024 * </ul>
025 * The compiler's character classes are those of Latin-1, so a character after
026 * {@code U+00FF} is an error anywhere, in a string or a comment too.
027 * A column counts characters, and a tab moves to the next column after a
028 * multiple of 8, as in the compiler's messages.
029 * <p>
030 * The lexer does not stop at an error, as the compiler's does: an unexpected
031 * character is reported and skipped, and an unterminated string or comment is
032 * reported and ends the input.
033 */
034public final class ClaferLexer {
035
036    /**
037     * The reserved words of {@code clafer.cf}.
038     */
039    static final Set<String> Keywords = Set.of(
040            "F", "G", "U", "W", "X",
041            "abstract", "after", "all", "always", "and", "assert", "before", "between", "disj", "each",
042            "else", "enum", "eventually", "final", "finally", "finalref", "finaltarget", "follow",
043            "globally", "historically", "if", "in", "initial", "initially", "let", "lonce", "lone",
044            "max", "maximize", "min", "minimize", "must", "mux", "never", "next", "no", "not", "once",
045            "one", "opt", "or", "precede", "previous", "product", "since", "some", "sometime", "sum",
046            "then", "together", "triggered", "until", "weakuntil", "xor");
047
048    /**
049     * The symbols of {@code clafer.cf}, longest first so that the longest
050     * match wins.
051     */
052    private static final String[] Symbols = {
053        "-->>", "]->>",
054        "<=>", "->>", "-->", "]->",
055        "<<", ">>", "->", ":=", "..", "||", "&&", "=>", "<=", ">=", "!=", "<:", ":>", "++", "--", "**", "-[",
056        "=", "[", "]", "{", "}", "`", ":", "?", "+", "*", "|", "!", "<", ">", "-", "/", "%", "#", ",",
057        "&", ".", ";", "\\", "(", ")"
058    };
059
060    /**
061     * The tokens of a model.
062     *
063     * @param tokens the tokens for the parser, ending with
064     * {@link TokenKind#EOF}
065     * @param others the comments and escapes, in order
066     * @param diagnostics the errors, in order
067     */
068    public record Result(List<Token> tokens, List<Token> others, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics) {
069    }
070
071    private final String source;
072    private int pos = 0;
073    private int line = 1;
074    private int column = 1;
075    private final List<Token> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
076    private final List<Token> others = new ArrayList<>();
077    private final List<Diagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
078
079    private ClaferLexer(String source) {
080        this.source = source;
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Splits a model into tokens.
085     *
086     * @param source the text of the model
087     * @return the tokens, the comments and escapes, and the errors
088     */
089    public static Result lex(String source) {
090        ClaferLexer lexer = new ClaferLexer(source);
091        lexer.run();
092        return new Result(
093                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.tokens),
094                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.others),
095                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.diagnostics));
096    }
097
098    private void run() {
099        while (pos < source.length()) {
100            char c = source.charAt(pos);
101            if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f' || c == '\u000B') {
102                advance();
103            } else if (source.startsWith("//", pos)) {
104                lineComment();
105            } else if (source.startsWith("/*", pos)) {
106                blockComment();
107            } else if (source.startsWith("[alloy|", pos) || source.startsWith("[choco|", pos)) {
108                escape();
109            } else if (isLetter(c)) {
110                word();
111            } else if (isDigit(c)) {
112                number();
113            } else if (c == '"') {
114                string();
115            } else {
116                symbol();
117            }
118        }
119        tokens.add(new Token(TokenKind.EOF, "", SourceSpan.at(line, column)));
120    }
121
122    static boolean isLetter(char c) {
123        return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
124                || (c >= '\u00C0' && c <= '\u00FF' && c != '\u00D7' && c != '\u00F7');
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Moves past a character of a string, comment or escape, which must be
129     * a Latin-1 character; reports the first that is not in each token.
130     */
131    private boolean advanceLatin1(boolean reported) {
132        if (!reported && peek(0) > '\u00FF') {
133            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(SourceSpan.at(line, column),
134                    "Unexpected character " + describe(peek(0)) + ": only Latin-1 characters are allowed"));
135            reported = true;
136        }
137        advance();
138        return reported;
139    }
140
141    private static boolean isDigit(char c) {
142        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
143    }
144
145    private char peek(int offset) {
146        int i = pos + offset;
147        return i < source.length() ? source.charAt(i) : '\0';
148    }
149
150    /**
151     * Moves past one character, as Alex does: a tab to the column after the
152     * next multiple of 8, a line feed to the next line, anything else, a
153     * carriage return included, one column.
154     */
155    private void advance() {
156        char c = source.charAt(pos++);
157        if (c == '\n') {
158            line++;
159            column = 1;
160        } else if (c == '\t') {
161            column = ((column + 7) / 8) * 8 + 1;
162        } else {
163            column++;
164        }
165    }
166
167    private void advance(int n) {
168        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
169            advance();
170        }
171    }
172
173    private Token emit(List<Token> into, TokenKind kind, int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {
174        Token token = new Token(kind, source.substring(startPos, pos), new SourceSpan(startLine, startColumn, line, column));
175        into.add(token);
176        return token;
177    }
178
179    private void lineComment() {
180        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
181        boolean reported = false;
182        while (pos < source.length() && source.charAt(pos) != '\n') {
183            reported = advanceLatin1(reported);
184        }
185        emit(others, TokenKind.COMMENT, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
186    }
187
188    private void blockComment() {
189        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
190        advance(2);
191        boolean reported = false;
192        while (pos < source.length() && !source.startsWith("*/", pos)) {
193            reported = advanceLatin1(reported);
194        }
195        if (pos < source.length()) {
196            advance(2);
197            emit(others, TokenKind.COMMENT, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
198        } else {
199            unterminated("comment", startPos, startLine, startColumn);
200        }
201    }
202
203    /**
204     * {@code [alloy| ... |]}: up to the first {@code |]}.
205     */
206    private void escape() {
207        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
208        advance(7);
209        boolean reported = false;
210        while (pos < source.length() && !source.startsWith("|]", pos)) {
211            reported = advanceLatin1(reported);
212        }
213        if (pos < source.length()) {
214            advance(2);
215            emit(others, TokenKind.ESCAPE, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
216        } else {
217            unterminated("escape", startPos, startLine, startColumn);
218        }
219    }
220
221    private void unterminated(String what, int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {
222        diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(new SourceSpan(startLine, startColumn, line, column), "Unterminated " + what));
223    }
224
225    private void word() {
226        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
227        while (pos < source.length() && (isLetter(peek(0)) || isDigit(peek(0)) || peek(0) == '_' || peek(0) == '\'')) {
228            advance();
229        }
230        String text = source.substring(startPos, pos);
231        emit(tokens, Keywords.contains(text) ? TokenKind.KEYWORD : TokenKind.WORD, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
232    }
233
234    /**
235     * An integer, a real if a point and a digit follow the digits, so that
236     * {@code 1..2} is a range of integers, and a double if an exponent follows
237     * the real.
238     */
239    private void number() {
240        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
241        digits();
242        TokenKind kind = TokenKind.INT;
243        if (peek(0) == '.' && isDigit(peek(1))) {
244            kind = TokenKind.DECIMAL;
245            advance();
246            digits();
247            int sign = peek(1) == '-' ? 1 : 0;
248            if (peek(0) == 'e' && isDigit(peek(1 + sign))) {
249                kind = TokenKind.DOUBLE;
250                advance(1 + sign);
251                digits();
252            }
253        }
254        emit(tokens, kind, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
255    }
256
257    private void digits() {
258        while (pos < source.length() && isDigit(peek(0))) {
259            advance();
260        }
261    }
262
263    /**
264     * A string, which may span lines. An unknown escape is reported, and the
265     * string goes on after it.
266     */
267    private void string() {
268        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
269        advance();
270        boolean reported = false;
271        while (pos < source.length()) {
272            char c = peek(0);
273            if (c == '"') {
274                advance();
275                emit(tokens, TokenKind.STRING, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
276                return;
277            }
278            if (c == '\\') {
279                int escapeLine = line, escapeColumn = column;
280                advance();
281                if (pos < source.length() && "\"\\nt".indexOf(peek(0)) < 0) {
282                    diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(SourceSpan.at(escapeLine, escapeColumn),
283                            "Unknown escape in a string; use \\\", \\\\, \\n or \\t"));
284                }
285                if (pos < source.length()) {
286                    advance();
287                }
288            } else {
289                reported = advanceLatin1(reported);
290            }
291        }
292        unterminated("string", startPos, startLine, startColumn);
293    }
294
295    private void symbol() {
296        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
297        for (String symbol : Symbols) {
298            if (source.startsWith(symbol, pos)) {
299                advance(symbol.length());
300                emit(tokens, TokenKind.SYMBOL, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
301                return;
302            }
303        }
304        char c = peek(0);
305        advance();
306        diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(SourceSpan.at(startLine, startColumn), "Unexpected character " + describe(c)));
307    }
308
309    private static String describe(char c) {
310        return c >= ' ' && c <= '~' ? "'" + c + "'" : String.format("U+%04X", (int) c);
311    }
312}
